annotations.title: Give a Discord member a role

description: Give one member of the brand's Discord server a role. userId is the member id (search_discord_members); role is its id or exact name. A role can unlock channels and powers, so call it WITHOUT confirm first: nothing changes and you get a sentence naming the member, what the role carries and how many members hold it. The role must sit below the Hermoso role. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

confirm.description: true only once the user agreed

discordServer.description: which Discord server (id or name) when the bot is in several

role.description: the role id or exact name

name: assign_discord_role
